mission: Fix the transient white oval that flashes when the cursor enters an administrative district in the 港都人物誌 3D explorer.
status: fixed; app-side root cause identified and regression-tested

rootCause.mechanism: The district hover handler updates hoveredAdminId in CityExplorer, which re-renders CityWorld and ActorLayer. ActorLayer previously created new CircleGeometry, MeshBasicMaterial, and args array objects inline for <instancedMesh>. React Three Fiber treated the changed args as a new InstancedMesh. A newly created InstancedMesh has identity matrices for every instance until the layout effect uploads actor matrices, so all 106 white circle instances briefly overlapped at the world origin. depthTest false and renderOrder 4 drew that cluster over the map, below the DOM HUD.
rootCause.trigger: Any district hover state change (pointer enters a district mesh) that re-renders ActorLayer.
rootCause.whyTransient: The useLayoutEffect uploads the real 106 instance matrices after the first render; the identity-matrix frame exists only for 1-2 rendered frames.
rootCause.evidence: Controlled A/B with window.__kaohsiungActorMarker: old inline args changed InstancedMesh UUID 9c852588-bc46-4afa-952a-de9db12da408 -> 74738624-9e62-4af2-8824-25f87b2e48b6 on hover; fixed stable args kept UUID de00d32f-08a3-4d44-a774-faa434f09ae4 before and after hover.

fix.summary: Use module-level stable marker geometry/material and a memoized args tuple keyed only by actor count; the InstancedMesh is no longer recreated by hover or other parent re-renders.
fix.testOnlyHook: window.__kaohsiungActorMarker reads markerRef.current.uuid and count; cleaned up on unmount.
preserved: district hover feedback and pointer cursor
camera zoom/restore, avatar scale 0.07, hero streaming and scene partition

after.color: beige map surface; no neutral disk
after.note: Frames 10-15 were captured after hovering E01 with the fixed code. The sampled point is stable beige, not #E3E3E3.

regressionCoverage: hover after manual pan and wheel zoom
